title: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
abstract: arXiv:2611.34051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear attention offers an efficient solution for long-sequence modeling via linear complexity and fixed-size recurrent states. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) introduces independent channel-wise control over erasure and writing, enhancing state-update expressiveness and in-context retrieval, yet it suffers from training failures during long-context training. We trace these failures to the asymmetry between reading and modification directions during erasure, which yields non-normal erase operators whose directional gains accumulate across tokens, triggering exponential state growth even without new writes. To resolve this, we propose \model{}, employing symmetric erasure to ensure non-expansive state propagation and decay-regulated residual writing to preserve writing flexibility. Theoretically, we establish an $O(\sqrt{T})$ upper bound on recurrent state growth while retaining chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on ~1.6B parameter mode

translated_title: 稳定的门控DeltaNet-2：理解与缓解循环状态不稳定性
translated_abstract: 线性注意力凭借线性复杂度和固定大小的循环状态，为长序列建模提供了高效解决方案。门控DeltaNet-2（GDN-2）引入了对擦除和写入的独立通道级控制，增强了状态更新的表达能力以及上下文内检索能力，但它在长上下文训练中会出现训练失败。我们将这些失败归因于擦除过程中读取方向与修改方向之间的不对称性，这种不对称性产生了非正规（non-normal）的擦除算子，其方向性增益会在token之间累积，即使没有新的写入也会引发状态的指数级增长。为解决这一问题，我们提出了该模型，采用对称擦除以确保状态传播的非扩张性，并通过衰减调节的残差写入来保留写入的灵活性。在理论上，我们在保留分块并行计算的同时，建立了循环状态增长的 O(√T) 上界。在约16亿参数模型上的实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现GDN-2训练失败源于擦除操作中读写方向不对称导致的循环状态指数级增长，并提出通过对称擦除与衰减调节残差写入来解决该问题，同时理论上证明了状态增长的O(√T)上界并保留分块并行计算能力。
